description:
Get a resolved book's portfolio: market-cap-weighted vs SPY ("cap", the default, the portfolio the ledger's
    verdict grades) or equal-weighted vs RSP ("equal"), with each long pick's weight and graded return, the book
    return, the benchmark return and its evidence, alpha and verdict. Equal weights always pair with RSP and cap weights
    with SPY. Per prediction, books serve the two as equal_weight and market_cap_weight; never read a pick's cap_weight
    as either without checking inference_metadata.weighting. Use this for one book's result, and get_simulation_nav for
    the running portfolio across books. An ungraded or unknown date is an error.

trading_date.description: The book's trading date, as YYYY-MM-DD. list_resolved_batches gives the graded dates.
trading_date.title: Trading Date

weighting.description: "cap" for market-cap weights against SPY (the default), or "equal" for equal weights against RSP.
weighting.title: Weighting

name: get_book_portfolio
title: Book portfolio
